messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> P1: inference_us-east — elevated 5xx rate and timeouts. Auto-assigning on-call.
sara: I'm on call, joining. war room link: https://meet.redwood.com/r/4938274560 (private)
mike_oncall: On my way. Confirming paging arrived. @sara do you want owner or should I take initial comms?
jenna_support: I'll start a statuspage draft and surface the top customers. Impact estimate pls.
ryan_sre: Starting log tails and metric checks: `kubectl logs -f inference-pool --since=5m` and `promql: sum(rate(errors[1m])) by (region)`
sara: I'll take owner for triage. First hypothesis: KV cache thrash after recent model rollout. Checking cache hit rates.
mike_oncall: I'll prepare external messaging and coordinate fallback routing if needed. Paging acked by all paged oncall.
jenna_support: Draft internal status (internal/status-draft): "Partial outage affecting inference in us-east — increased error rate, degraded latency. Working on mitigation." Will paste once we confirm.
lia_prod: Notifying top customers on the emergency list after we validate impact. Please confirm customer-facing wording before send.
sara: Quick mitigation: hold further rollouts, disable aggressive cache invalidation job, and test fallback to smaller model. Starting now.
mike_oncall: Triggering fallback routing to compatible model variant: `route apply --fallback model-v1-quant` — change id r-2432. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Routing change r-2432 applied. New 5xx rate dropping from ~18% -> ~7% within 2m.
ryan_sre: Observability shows reduced latency and lower CPU on the main pool. Continuing to watch KV hit ratio and queue depth.
jenna_support: External statuspage draft ready: "Degraded inference performance in US-East; we've routed traffic to a compatible model to reduce errors. Engineers investigating root cause." Waiting approval.
lia_prod: Hold on external until we confirm exact customer impact list. I'll prepare targeted emails for the affected accounts.
sara: Approved to publish the status page once we confirm error rate <10% for 10 minutes. Meanwhile everyone add notes to the incident doc: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/4938274560
mike_oncall: All paged folks acknowledged. I'll queue the status update once we hit the stability gate. :white_check_mark:
jenna_support: Adding customer templates to the doc. Preparing one-sentence TL;DR and technical appendix.
sara: War room active. Assigning follow-ups: @ryan_sre keep observing, @mike_oncall take comms, @jenna_support coordinate support, @lia_prod prep customer list. I'll continue triage and post updates here.
incident-bot: Reminder: escalate to oncall-sre-2 if no progress in 20 minutes.
_meta: Generated synthetic Slack thread for internal incident kickoff coordination. Contains root message and replies in chronological order. No title field included per agents.md.
